title: P@x settings
description: What the session service of P@x keeps about P@x itself, in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tur/pax/settings.json: whether the person switched it on, which consent text they accepted, the provider and model, and the spending limits. Written only by tur-pax serve, on a request through org.tur.Agent1. It never holds a key: the key is in the password store of the session. The loader in services/tur-pax (settings.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: the model name has no control characters and no surrounding whitespace; a limit in money is above 0 and at most 100000; a limit in tokens is at least 1 and at most 100000000000. A file that cannot be read leaves P@x switched off.

enabled.description: Whether the person switched P@x on. False when absent.

consent.description: The acceptance of the text that says what is sent to the provider.

text_version.description: The version of the text that was accepted.

accepted_at.description: When, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

model.description: The model name as the provider spells it. Configuration: no name is compiled in.

base_url.description: A compatible gateway. Set only by editing this file, never through the interface, because whoever it names is sent the key. Removed when the provider changes. The provider layer's rules apply: https, or http for a loopback host only.

max_output_tokens.description: The output limit of one response. Without it, the model list's, then 4096.

limits.description: The spending limits. One that is absent has its default: 1.00 a task and 5.00 a day in the currency of the prices, or 400000 tokens a task and 2000000 a day for a model whose price is not known.
